title: COMMAND THE NEW WEEK
text: Glory be to God. [music] I want you to understand something this morning that is going to shift your entire perspective concerning time, concerning seasons, and concerning the authority that heaven has invested in the believer. You see, many believers go into a new week the same way unbelievers go into a new week casually, passively as though they have no say in what happens. But I want to show you from the scriptures that you have been given authority to command your week. When God created Adam and placed him in the garden, the first instruction was what? Subdue the earth and have dominion. Dominion is not passive. Dominion is active. Dominion is authority in manifestation. And so this morning, we are not just going to wish ourselves well. We are going to take authority over every second, every minute, every hour, every day of this new week in the mighty name of Jesus. I need you to pay attention because what I'm about to share with you is not just religious information. It is spiritual intelligence that [music] when you apply it will change the course of your life. You see the Bible says in Ephesians 1:3, "Blessed be the God and father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ Jesus." Notice the tense. Has blessed, not will bless, not might bless. has blessed everything you need for this week has already been provided in the heavenly realms. Your job is to command it into manifestation. Now I want you to understand the spiritual dynamics of time. Time is not just a physical phenomenon. Time has spiritual dimensions. There are times and seasons. Ecclesiastes 3:1 says to everything there is a season and a time to every purpose under heaven. You see, before anything happens in the physical, it has already been orchestrated in the spiritual. And the believer who understands spiritual authority knows how to reach into the realm of the spirit and pull down into manifestation what heaven has already made available. This is why the scripture says in Matthew 18:18, "Whatsoever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven, and whatsoever you shall lose on earth shall be loosed in heaven." This is legal authority. This is judicial power. When you speak in the name of Jesus, you are not making [music] requests. You are issuing decrees. You are enforcing the will of heaven on earth. And this morning, we are going to enforce the will of heaven over this new week. I want you to catch this. Your words are spiritual containers. Proverbs 18:21 says, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." Every word you speak is either activating life or activating death. Every declaration you make is either opening doors or closing doors. And so we must become very deliberate, very intentional about what we say concerning our lives, concerning our families, concerning our businesses, concerning our ministries. You know, there are people who prophesy their own failure with their mouth. They wake up in the morning and say, "This week is going to be terrible. Nothing good ever happens to me. I'm tired of struggling." And they wonder why their life never changes. You are eating the fruit of your lips. The Bible says in Numbers 14:28, God said to the children of Israel, "As truly as I live, said the Lord. As you have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you." God is saying, "I heard what you said and I'm going to give you exactly what you prophesied. [music] But this morning, we are going to prophesy differently. We are going to prophesy life. We are going to prophesy breakthrough. We are going to prophesy divine acceleration. We are going to prophesy supernatural favor. We are going to prophesy angelic assistance. We are going to prophesy divine connection. We are going to prophesy financial overflow and heaven is going to say as you have spoken so shall it be. Now let me give you a scriptural foundation for commanding your weak. In Mark 11:23, Jesus said, "For verily I say unto you, that whosoever shall say unto this mountain, be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea, and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass." He shall have whatsoever he saith. Notice Jesus didn't say, "Whosoever shall pray about this mountain." He said, "Whosoever shall say unto this mountain," there is a dimension of prayer that is speaking. There is a dimension of intercession that is commanding. There is a dimension of spiritual warfare that is decreeing. Job 22:28 [music] says, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." Decree, not wish, NOT HOPE, NOT MAYBE. DECREE. When you decree, you are speaking with the authority of the kingdom. You are releasing the power of God's word. You are activating angelic forces. You are frustrating demonic assignments. You are aligning earthly circumstances with heavenly realities. I want you to see something powerful in Genesis chapter 1. When God was creating the world, how did he do it? He spoke. And God said, "Let there be light." And there was light. God didn't pray about light. God didn't hope for light. God didn't wish for light. God commanded light. And because you are created in the image and likeness of God, you carry that same creative power [music] in your tongue. When you speak in faith, when you speak in alignment with God's word, when you speak with spiritual authority, creation must respond. This is why I'm telling you this morning that [music] you cannot afford to be casual about this new week. The enemy has assignments. The enemy has plans. The enemy has strategies, but the Bible says in Isaiah 54:17, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall [music] prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn." This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, sayeth the Lord. Did you see that? You shall condemn. Not God will condemn. You shall condemn. You have been given authority to render powerless every satanic verdict, every demonic pronouncement, every witchcraft manipulation, every ancestral curse, every environmental limitation. Now, I need you to understand the power of the morning hour. Psalm 5:3 says, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." The morning is strategic. The morning is significant. What you do in the morning sets the tone for your entire day. When you take authority in the morning, when you decree in the morning, when you worship in the morning, when you declare the word in the morning, you are establishing spiritual order over your day. Mark 1:35 says, "And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed." Jesus understood the power of the morning. Before he engaged with the day, he engaged [music] with the father. Before he dealt with people, he dealt with heaven. Before he faced the challenges, he secured divine backing. And if Jesus needed to pray in the morning, how much more do we need to pray in the morning? This morning, we are standing in the gap. We are standing in the place of spiritual authority. We are standing in the office that God has given us as priests and kings unto God. 1 Peter chapter 2:9 says, "But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood and holy nation, a peculiar people that he should show forth the praises of him who had called you out of darkness into his marvelous light." You are a royal priesthood. You have priestly authority. You have kingly authority. And with that authority, you can decree divine order over your weak. Let me tell you something about the spirit [music] realm. It responds to authority, not to noise. It responds to faith, not to emotion. It responds to the word of God, not [music] to religious cliches. When you stand in the place of prayer with the word of God in your mouth, with faith in your heart, with the name of Jesus on your lips, all of hell trembles, demons scatter, obstacles dissolve, doors open, [music] provisions are released, helpers are activated, destiny connections are made. You see, many people are struggling this morning not because God is not willing to bless them, but because they have not learned how to take authority. They are still begging for what Jesus has already provided. They are still hoping for what God has already promised. They are still wishing for what the word has already guaranteed. But this morning, we are transitioning from begging to decreeing. We are transitioning from hoping to declaring. We are transitioning from wishing to commanding. Romans chapter 8:37 says, "Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us." More than conquerors, not victims, not beggars, not people at the mercy of circumstances, more than conquerors. [music] Conquerors take territory. Conquerors enforce victory. Conquerors rule and reign. And this week you are going to conquer every challenge, every obstacle, every limitation, every satanic agenda in the mighty name of Jesus. Now before we go into the prayer, I want to encourage you. Whatever you are about to receive this morning, don't keep it to yourself. Share this prayer [music] with someone. Send it to a family member. Post it in your group. Forward it to a friend who needs [music] to hear this. Because when you share the word, when you share prayer, when you share spiritual intelligence, [music] you are becoming a distribution center for heaven's blessings. And the Bible says in Proverbs 11:25, "The liberal soul shall be made fat, and he that water it shall be watered also himself. As you share this with others, God will multiply the blessing back to you." Let me take you quickly through Isaiah 45:2 where God says, "I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron." This is a prophetic promise. God is saying, "I will go before you before you step into Monday. God is already in Monday. Before you enter Tuesday, God is already in Tuesday. Before you face Wednesday, God is already in Wednesday. And he's making the crooked places straight. He's breaking gates of brass. He's cutting bars of iron. This week you will experience divine preparation. You will walk into situations that God has already prepared for your advantage. Deuteronomy 28:3 says, "And the Lord shall make thee the head and not the tail, and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath." This is your covenant identity. You are the head, not the tail. You are above, not beneath. And this week, you will experience head level blessings. You will experience above only favor. You will experience top tier opportunities. You will experience uncommon grace. You will operate from a position of spiritual advantage. I need you to understand something about spiritual warfare. You don't fight from a position of weakness. You fight from a position of victory. Colossians chapter 2:15 says, speaking of Jesus, and having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shoe of them openly, triumphing over them in it. Jesus already defeated the enemy. The victory is already won. Your job is to enforce that victory. Your job is to apply that victory. Your job is to walk in the reality of that victory. This is why we can speak with confidence this morning. This is why we can decree with authority this morning. This is why we can prophesy with faith this morning. Because we are not speaking as people hoping God will do something. [music] We are speaking as people who know what God has already done. We are not fighting for victory. We are fighting from victory. Isaiah 55:1 says, "So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth. It shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper [music] in the thing whereto I sent it. The word of God cannot fail. When you speak the word, you are releasing the creative power of God. You are activating the covenant. You are enforcing divine promises. And this morning, every word we speak is pregnant with divine power, saturated with Holy Ghost fire, backed by angelic forces, and guaranteed by the faithfulness of God. You know, Psalm 91 is a powerful covenant protection psalm. Verse 11 says, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways." This week, angelic protection is activated over your life. Angels are going before you. Angels are standing behind you. Angels are surrounding you. Angels are watching over your family. Angels are guarding your business. Angels [music] are protecting your finances. Angels are securing your destiny. You are walking under divine security this week. Philippians 4:1 19 says, "But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." Not some of your needs, all your needs, not according to the economy, according to his riches in glory. This week, divine supply is released. This week, financial doors are opening. This week, unexpected blessings are coming. This week, divine provision is manifesting. This week, you will testify of God's faithfulness. Now, let me tell you something about speaking over your weak. You are not manipulating God. You are not twisting God's arm. You are aligning yourself with what God has already said. You are agreeing with heaven. You are releasing your faith. You are activating covenant. When you speak in line with the word of God, you are simply saying, "God, I believe what you said and I'm calling it into manifestation." 2 Corinthians chapter 1:20 [music] says, "For all the promises of God in him are yay and in him amen unto the glory of God by us." All the promises are [music] yes in Christ. All the promises are amen in Christ. There is no promise of God that is expired. There is no promise of God that is canled. There is no promise of God that is unavailable. Every promise is alive. Every promise is active. Every promise is available. And this week you are stepping into the manifestation of multiple promises. Psalm 118:4 says, "This is the day which the Lord hath made. We will rejoice and be glad in it. Every day of this week is the day that the Lord has made." Not the day that the devil has made. Not the day that circumstances have made. The day that the Lord has made. And because the Lord has made it, it is loaded with possibilities. It is loaded with opportunities. It is loaded with blessings. It is loaded with breakthroughs. It is loaded with miracles. You see, your perspective determines your experience. If you see this week as just another week, [music] you will experience just another week. But if you see this week as a divinely orchestrated season of supernatural intervention, that is exactly what you will experience. Romans 12:2 says, "And be not conformed to this world, but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind." Your mind must be renewed, your perspective must be renewed, your expectation must be renewed. Jeremiah 29:1 says, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, sayeth the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you an expected end. God's thoughts toward you are thoughts [music] of peace, thoughts of good, thoughts of expected end. God is not thinking disaster over your life. God is not planning failure for your week. God is thinking promotion. God is thinking elevation. God is thinking multiplication. God is thinking acceleration. And this week, God's thoughts concerning you [music] are coming to pass. Now, let me show you something powerful in Psalm 23. It says, "The Lord is my shepherd. I shall not want. This week you shall not want, you shall not lack, you shall not be deficient, you shall not be in need. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures. This week you will experience rest in the midst of pressure. You will experience peace in the midst of chaos. He leadth me beside the still waters. This week divine guidance is activated. He restoreth my soul. This week everything the enemy has stolen is being restored. He leadth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake. This week you are walking in divine direction. Yay. Though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for thou art with me. This week, no matter what you face, God is with you. Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me. This week, divine protection is your portion. Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies. This week, God is setting you up for public blessing. Thou anointest my head with oil. This week fresh anointing is being [music] released. My cup runth over. This week you will experience overflow. Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life. This week goodness and mercy are following you. Not poverty, not failure, not disappointment. Goodness and mercy. Hallelujah. Now we're stepping into the place of prayer and prophetic declaration. I want you to open your mouth and begin to agree with me. Begin to decree with me. Begin to prophesy with me. Don't just listen, participate. Your voice carries authority. Your words carry power. Lift up your voice and let heaven hear you. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, we come before your throne this morning with thanksgiving and praise. We bless your holy name. We magnify your holy name. We exalt your holy name. You are the King of Kings. You are the Lord of Lords. You are the ancient of days. You are the beginning and the end. You are the alpha and omega. You are El Shadai, the allsufficient one. You are Jehovah Gyre, [music] our provider. You are Jehovah Rafa, our healer. You are Jehovah Ni, our banner. You are Jehovah Shalom, our peace. And we worship you this morning in spirit and in truth. Father, we thank you for the gift of life. We thank you for seeing us through last week. We thank you for bringing us into this new week. We thank you that we are alive. We thank you that we are healthy. We thank you that we are in our right minds. We thank you for your grace. We thank you for your mercy. We thank you for your faithfulness. Everything we are and everything we have is because of you. Now, Father, in the name of Jesus, we take authority over this new week. We decree that this week is blessed. This week is favored. This week is anointed. This week [music] is appointed for supernatural breakthroughs. This week is pregnant with divine possibilities. This week is loaded with heavenly opportunities. And we command every satanic agenda, every demonic assignment, every witchcraft manipulation, every ancestral curse, every environmental limitation to be destroyed by the fire of the Holy Ghost in the mighty name of Jesus. Every plan of the enemy for this week, we abort it now. Every trap that has been set, we destroy it now. Every ambush that has been arranged, we scatter it now. Every conspiracy that has been formed, we dismantle it now. Every weapon that has been fashioned, we render it powerless now. Every tongue that has risen in judgment, we condemn it now. Every satanic verdict, we nullify it now. Every demonic pronouncement, we cancel it now. In the mighty name of Jesus, we command angelic forces to be activated over our lives this week. Angels of the Lord go before us and prepare the way. Angels of the Lord stand behind us and secure our path. Angels of the Lord surround us with divine protection. Angels of the Lord fight on our behalf. Angels of the Lord release provision. Angels of the Lord, orchestrate divine connections. Angels of the Lord, open doors that no man can shut. Angels of the Lord, we receive your ministry in our lives this [music] week. In the mighty name of Jesus, we decree that this week, we shall not stumble. We shall not fall. We shall not fail. We shall not be disgraced. We shall not be disappointed. We shall not be disadvantaged. We shall not be defeated. We are victorious. We are triumphant. We are overcomers. We are more than conquerors through Christ Jesus. This week we walk in victory. We talk in victory. We live in victory. We operate in [music] victory. Victory is our heritage. Victory is our portion. Victory is our testimony in the mighty name of Jesus. Every door that needs to open this week, we command it to open now. Doors of opportunity open. Doors of financial breakthrough open. Doors of promotion open. Doors of elevation open. Doors of divine connection open. Doors of marital settlement open. Doors of business expansion open. Doors of ministerial acceleration open. We decree that this week we are walking through open doors that no man can shut. And every door that needs to be shut, we command it to be shut now. Doors of frustration shut. Doors of disappointment shut. Doors of satanic attack shut. Doors of poverty shut. Doors of sickness shut. Doors of failure shut. In the mighty name of Jesus, we take authority over Monday. Monday you are blessed. Monday you are anointed. Monday you are favored. Every plan of God for Monday shall come to pass. Every assignment from heaven for Monday a shall be accomplished. Monday will not be a day of struggle. Monday will be a day of breakthrough. Monday will not be a day of frustration. Monday will be a day of favor. Monday will not be a day of disappointment. Monday will be a day of divine surprises. We decree that Monday [music] is blessed in the mighty name of Jesus. Tuesday we command you to align with the will of God. Tuesday you will bring testimonies. Tuesday you will bring blessings. Tuesday [music] you will bring breakthroughs. Tuesday you will bring uncommon favor. Everything that the enemy has planned for Tuesday we destroy it. Now everything that heaven has ordained for Tuesday, we activate it now. Tuesday is loaded with divine interventions. Tuesday is pregnant with supernatural manifestations. Tuesday is blessed in the mighty name of Jesus. Wednesday we decree that you are a day of acceleration. Wednesday you will fasttrack divine purposes. Wednesday you will bring answered prayers. Wednesday you will bring financial overflow. Wednesday you will bring divine connections. Wednesday you will bring ministerial breakthroughs. We decree that what was supposed to take months will happen on Wednesday. What was supposed to take years will manifest on Wednesday. Wednesday is a day of divine speed. Wednesday is blessed in the mighty name of Jesus. Thursday we take authority over you. Thursday you will not bring bad news, you will bring good news. [music] Thursday you will not bring sorrow, you will bring joy. Thursday you will not bring defeat, you will bring victory. We decree that Thursday is a day of testimonies. Thursday is a day of celebration. Thursday is a day of divine manifestations. Everything that has been delayed in our lives, Thursday will bring the release. Thursday is blessed in the mighty name of Jesus. Friday we command you to cooperate with divine purposes. Friday you are a day of completion. Friday you are a day of fulfillment. Friday you are a day of divine finishing. Every project that needs to be completed this week, Friday will bring completion. Every prayer that needs to be answered this week, Friday will bring answers. Every need that needs to be met this week, Friday will bring provision. Friday is blessed in the mighty name of Jesus. Saturday and Sunday, we decree that you are days [music] of rest and refreshing, days of worship and thanksgiving, days of celebration and testimonies. We will spend you in the presence of God. We will spend you in fellowship with the saints. We will spend you in gratitude and praise. Saturday and Sunday are blessed in the mighty name of Jesus. Now, Father, we speak over our finances this [music] week. We decree that this week is a week of financial breakthrough. This week is a week of supernatural provision. This week is a week of overflow. We command every debt to be [music] canceled, every financial burden to be lifted, every financial limitation to be broken. We decree that this week money will locate us, contracts will locate us, clients will locate us, customers will locate us, investors will locate us, divine helpers will locate us. We will not beg for what God has already provided. We will not struggle for what heaven has already released. This week we are experiencing financial overflow in the mighty name of Jesus. We speak over our health this week. We decree that this week we walk in divine health. We walk in supernatural strength. We walk in uncommon energy. Every sickness we command you to live now. Every disease we command you to die now. Every infirmity we command you to be healed now. Every pain we command you to disappear now. We decree that by the stripes of Jesus we are healed. By the blood of Jesus we are made whole. This week our bodies are temples of the Holy Ghost. This week we are strong in the Lord and in the power of his might. This week we are walking in divine health in the mighty name of Jesus. We speak [music] over our families. This week we decree that every member of our family is covered by the blood of Jesus. Every child is protected. Every spouse is secured. Every parent is guarded. We command every satanic attack against our families to be destroyed. Every plan of the enemy against our homes to be frustrated. Every strategy of hell against our marriages to be dismantled. We decree that our families are [music] blessed. Our families are favored. Our families are anointed. Our families are walking in divine order. Our families are experiencing peace. Our families are experiencing unity. Our families are experiencing love. Our families are blessed in the mighty name of Jesus. We speak over our careers and businesses this week. We decree that this week brings promotion. This week brings elevation. This week brings expansion. We command every opposition at our workplaces to be silenced. Every enemy in our offices to be put to shame. Every conspiracy against our advancement to be scattered. We decree that this week our bosses will favor us. Our colleagues will celebrate us. Our clients will appreciate us. Our businesses will prosper. Our careers will advance. We are the head and not the tail. We are both only and not beneath. This week we are experiencing career and business breakthroughs in the mighty name of Jesus. We speak over our ministries this week. Every minister of the gospel hearing this prayer, we decree that this week your ministry is anointed. Your ministry is empowered. Your ministry is accelerated. This week, souls will be saved. Lives will be transformed. Miracles will happen. Deliverances will manifest. We command every satanic resistance against your ministry to be broken. Every spiritual warfare to be won, every attack to be defeated. This week, your ministry is going to the next level in the mighty name of Jesus. We speak over our relationships and connections. This week we decree that this week we will meet the right people. We will connect with destiny helpers. We will encounter divine orchestrations. Every wrong relationship we command separation. Every toxic connection we command disconnection. Every unprofitable association we command termination. But every divine connection we command activation. Every destiny helper we command location. This week we are meeting people who will take us to our next level in the mighty name of Jesus. We speak over our minds. This week we decree that this week we woke in the mind of Christ. Our thoughts are aligned with heaven. Our minds are renewed by the word. We cast down every imagination that exalts itself against the knowledge of God. We bring every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ. This week depression cannot find us. Anxiety cannot locate us. Fear cannot control us. Confusion cannot manipulate us. We are walking in clarity. We are walking in peace. We are walking in wisdom. We are walking in understanding. Our minds are blessed in the mighty name of Jesus. We speak over our spiritual lives this week. We decree that this week our prayer lives are on fire. Our worship is favven. Our study of the word is consistent. Our fellowship with the Holy Spirit is intimate. This week we are growing in grace. We are growing in knowledge. We are growing in spiritual authority. We are growing in prophetic insight. This week we are experiencing deeper dimensions in God. We are encountering fresh revelations. We are receiving new impartations. Our spiritual lives are blessed in the mighty name of Jesus. Father, we decree that this week your glory will be manifested in our lives. Your power will be demonstrated through us. Your name will be glorified in our testimonies. We will not be quiet about what you are doing. We will testify of your goodness. We will declare your faithfulness. We will proclaim your mercies. This week, our lives will be a testimony that points people to you. Our breakthroughs will bring glory to your name. Our testimonies will bring others to salvation. We are living epistles read of all men. Now we seal everything we have decreed with the blood of Jesus. We cover this week with the blood. [music] We cover our lives with the blood. We cover our families with the blood. We cover our finances with the blood. We cover our health with the blood. We cover our businesses with the blood. We cover our ministries with the blood. The blood of Jesus speaks better things. The blood of Jesus cleanses. The blood of Jesus protects. The blood of Jesus sanctifies. The blood of Jesus delivers. The blood of Jesus heals. [music] The blood of Jesus provides. We plead the blood over this week. And we declare that it is settled in heaven. It is settled on earth. It is settled in our lives. This week is blessed. This week is commanded. This week is anointed. This week is favored. This week is victorious. And we receive it by faith. We walk in it by faith. We testify of it by faith. In the mighty name of Jesus, we have prayed. Now, lift up your voice and begin to thank God for answered prayer. Begin to worship him for what he has done. Begin to magnify him for the victory that is already yours. This week is blessed. This week is commanded. You are walking [music] into a week of supernatural manifestations. Share this prayer. Send it to someone who needs it and watch God perform wonders in your life. Glory be to God. Hallelujah. This week is yours in Jesus mighty name.
